final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS appearance_count FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON a.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL AND p.bats <> '' GROUP BY p.bats) SELECT batting_hand, appearance_count, appearance_count * 1.0 / SUM(appearance_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, appearance_count * 1.0 / AVG(appearance_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM hand_counts
